description: IMPL-026: the write-off at disposal is what stands on the asset account, not what an as-of query says stood there on the disposal date. A yearly depreciation run books the whole year in one entry dated 31 December. Disposing the asset on 30 September then asked two different questions about the same fact: the catch-up walks the PLAN and finds every month recorded, so it books nothing, while the carrying amount was read as of the disposal date, ignored the 31 December entry as later, and reported the full acquisition cost as still carried. The disposal wrote off 3600.00 of an asset the books valued at 2400.00 and left the asset account at -1200.00 — a credit balance on an asset account that nothing ever clears, while every invariant held and the entry balanced. Fixed by reading the carrying amount from the whole ledger, which is what every other caller of the accumulated depreciation already does: what leaves the account must equal what stands on it (F-AST-004). In the other order — disposal first, then the run — the books were always right, which is what made this easy to miss. Deliberately NOT changed: that the disposal year's depreciation is time-apportioned to the disposal month. Whether the year an asset leaves in grants a full year, half a year or nine months is a jurisdiction's answer (IMPL-022 records the same reasoning for the catch-up), so it belongs in a pack and not in this code. Here the year's run had already committed to twelve months; the disposal takes the difference as its result and the total hitting the income statement is the same 1600.00 either way.

expect.comment: 36 months from January — 100.00 a month, the plan month falling due on the last day of its month.
The whole year in one entry: twelve plan months, 1200.00, dated 31 December. That posting date is what the disposal used to trip over.

Every plan month is already recorded, so the catch-up books nothing. The carrying amount is 3600.00 - 1200.00 = 2400.00, sold for 2000.00, so 400.00 of loss. Before the fix the carrying amount was read as of 30 September, came out at 3600.00, and the disposal wrote off 1200.00 more than the account held.

The row that carries the finding is 0500: 3600.00 in, 1200.00 depreciation and 2400.00 write-off out, balance 0.00. Before the fix it read 3600.00 debit against 4800.00 credit and a balance of -1200.00. The result is split 1200.00 depreciation (6500) and 400.00 disposal loss (6900); together with the 2000.00 proceeds that is the 3600.00 the asset cost.
The register reports the depreciation as depreciation — 1200.00 for the year, not swallowed by the disposal result.
